req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The view_cookies handler reads request.cookies, filters ENV_COOKIES when hide_env=True and show_env not in args, then returns jsonify(cookies=cookies). Tests must cover: (1) positive - cookies present are echoed exactly; (2) negative - no cookies yields empty dict; (3) boundary - single cookie (BVA at count=1); (4) multiple cookies (EP); (5) show_env query param disables env-cookie filtering (DT); (6) wrong HTTP method (NEG). Mutation-resilient assertions check exact status code 200, exact JSON key 'cookies', exact cookie values, and exact empty dict.

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value
preconditions: One cookie is set on the request
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing one name=value pair
expected: cookies dict contains exactly the one cookie with exact value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_single():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'session': 'abc123'}

test_get_cookies_single()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_multiple_cookies_all_echoed
preconditions: Multiple cookies are set on the request
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing three name=value pairs
expected: JSON body cookies dict contains all three cookies with exact values
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_multiple():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'a=1; b=hello; c=world'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['a'] == '1'
    assert data['cookies']['b'] == 'hello'
    assert data['cookies']['c'] == 'world'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 3

test_get_cookies_multiple()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_response_json_top_level_key_is_cookies_not_other
actions: Verify JSON structure has exactly the 'cookies' key
expected: Top-level JSON key is 'cookies' (not 'cookie', not 'data', not 'headers')
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_exact_key_name():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'mykey=myval'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'cookie' not in data
    assert 'data' not in data

actions: Send GET /cookies with exactly two cookies
expected: cookies dict has exactly 2 entries with correct values

def test_get_cookies_two_cookies():

    assert r.status_code == 200

    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 2

tests.name: test_get_cookies_state_transition_set_then_list
preconditions: Cookie is set via /cookies/set then listed via /cookies
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_state_set_then_list():
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        pass
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'myCookie=myValue'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'].get('myCookie') == 'myValue'
    assert data['cookies']['myCookie'] == 'myValue'
